author: Mehrp
body:
So I've been looking around and having a nosey around the forums when I saw ' teams' upon discovering this I thought it would be nice to give it a go:
Pros: I'm pretty good at rushing a monument (or some people say)
I can strategize a map after having a quick look at it birds eye view.
I'm friendly and although very 'excited' I can be mature in a serious situation.
I've had a fair amount of experience in this sort of gameplay.
Normally have a few hours online every day
Very able to communicate with other teams members.
Versatile in positions
Won the Minecraft parkour tourney at i53 (UK gaming festival)

Cons: regular ping spikes that exceed 3000ms :(
Although better that a lot, my PvP does have room to improve (but I hope an experience in a team would improve that)
I talk to much.
 Can be immature (very rarely)
I'm new to this team thing

Other points:
UK based
13 years old
I have Skype and teakspeak (ask me for me Skype if interested)

Thanks for reading ^-^
